mathematical_contract.cyclic_rotation: A closed boundary has no distinguished geometric vector seam. If and only if the first analytic fragment begins at a nonrepresented parameter, the offset authority searches the existing borrowed fragment slice for a represented analytic traversal start, then processes exactly the original fragment count with modular indices. The bounded remaining-run length prevents revisiting or consuming a fragment twice.
mathematical_contract.partition_elision: The rotated run is composed only when every consecutive fragment has the same exact analytic carrier, traversal direction, adjacent retained parameter ranges, and the same nonzero derivative-scale sign. Its internal algebraic endpoint is then an arrangement partition rather than a geometric join, and the maximal represented outer range denotes the same exact branch.
mathematical_contract.cusp_guard: A derivative-scale sign change remains a hard coalescing boundary. Such a parameter is an old cusp whose limiting traversal normals may select different composed distances, so no cyclic rotation may erase it or synthesize finite coordinates.
mathematical_contract.fast_path: Materialized starts and analytic starts with represented parameters retain the original constant-time entry path. The cyclic search is paid only by the previously failing nonrepresented-seam case and allocates no fragments or auxiliary index storage.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 return structurally identical exact CurveRegion2 values for ordinary and cyclic partition placement in both traversal directions. APPROXIMATE_512 remains only a final unresolved equality/sign terminal and never approximates the carrier, partition, or topology.
